summary: Validated the redesigned SpendGuard landing page at the public frontend URL across desktop, tablet, and mobile. The revised hero, editorial sections, four trust rows, live Sony decision, RTX evidence conflict, Trust Receipt, timeline, metrics, console preview, final CTA, reduced-motion behavior, and anchor navigation all passed visual and interaction checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Open Console intentionally preserves the previous in-page destination and scrolls to the product preview. Standalone ESLint was unavailable because the starter has no ESLint v9 config file; production build passes.
rca of the issue: An intermediate redesign regression occurred because the shared Reveal wrapper dropped data-testid props. The wrapper now forwards props, and affected evidence, timeline, and console-preview interactions were retested successfully.
